reason: I already paid for a mass-DM tool, got no replies and an action block, so anything that sends Instagram DMs for me makes me flinch. $147 a month is a lot when I make $27k a year and my pipeline is already shaky, and there are no customer results to show it works.
objection: Will this get my Instagram account restricted or banned? It runs on my own account, so if it does, I lose the account my clients see, and the card is charged after day 3 with no refunds. Nobody has published a result yet either.
would_change_my_mind: Real customers, with names I can check, showing replies and booked calls without their accounts getting restricted. A price closer to $50-70 would also help, or a refund if the account gets blocked.
